What a crew! I’m honored the to receive the @law [image: What a crew! I’m honored the to receive the @lawyerscommitteerhodeisland 2026 Legislative Leader award alongside some particularly noteworthy colleagues. The Lawyer’s Committee popped up when Rhode Island needed it - because we’re not ceding our state and our values to a morally bankrupt national administration. They have been fighting the good fight...and winning! I’m grateful and proud to be in it with them, and with Majority Leader Frank Ciccone, RIBLIA Caucus co-chair Senator @mackdistrict6, and two superstar legislators from the other chamber, Representative @jbatista501 and Representative @brandonpotterri. And a shout-out @matt10202, who brought the idea for the Protect our Courts Act (he’s from Massachusetts, but we’ll claim him as one of our own). Together, we got four bills across the finish line this year that create accountability and protect Rhode Islanders from the illegal and immoral secret police force that has been running roughshod over our rights. These were big-deal bills. And we have more to do. Other things are coming when we reconvene in January, but for now - take care of each other. Love each other hard. Protect each other fiercely. Justice is what love looks like in public.]

While apples and honey are customary for Rosh Hash [image: While apples and honey are customary for Rosh Hashanah, our grapevines bore fruit this year like they never have before. I didn’t know that grapes could taste so utterly perfect. L’Shana Tova, and may this year be sweetened by our care for one another, our solidarity, and our striving for justice 🍇]
